item.title: Almost 20% of ICBs still not providing tirzepatide
item.description: Eight of 42 integrated care boards have not yet started to provide access to tirzepatide to eligible patients, it has been reported.

item.title: Generics annual review: Including first generic versions of major diabetes and heart drugs
item.description: Last year saw the launches of the first generic SGLT2 inhibitor and the first generic version of the antiplatelet ticagrelor, as well as the debranding of a combined HRT tablet.

item.title: Steps taken to resolve aspirin supply disruption
item.description: To preserve aspirin supplies, the DHSC has ruled that the drug cannot be exported or hoarded.

item.title: Consider HRT in perimenopausal women with long COVID, says new guidance
item.description: HRT may be trialled in people with long COVID who are experiencing perimenopause, the Royal College of Nursing has advised in a new guideline on menopause and long COVID.

item.title: ADHD medication use in UK women increases more than 20-fold in 13 years
item.description: Use of ADHD medication among UK women aged 25 years or older increased by more than 20-fold between 2010 and 2013, according to a new study.

item.title: Denosumab biosimilars summarised in new MIMS table
item.description: A comparison table of denosumab preparations is now available to MIMS subscribers, following a recent wave of biosimilar launches.

item.title: 'Profound perception change​' in ​gout management​​ called for, as treating​-to​-target linked to fewer cardiovascular events
item.description: Gout patients who achieved a serum urate level of less than 6mg/dL with urate-lowering treatment had a lower risk of major adverse cardiovascular events than those who did not, according to a new study.

item.title: ‘Breakthrough’ COPD treatment approved for NHS use
item.description: Dupilumab has been recommended as an add-on maintenance treatment option for adults with uncontrolled COPD and raised blood eosinophils, in final draft NICE guidance.

item.title: Statin prescribing information updated to highlight that most reported muscle symptoms not caused by the drugs
item.description: Product information for statins is being updated to reflect the fact that less than 10% of reported muscle-related adverse events are attributable to the medication.

item.title: Pancreatitis warnings strengthened for GLP-1 drugs
item.description: Increased vigilance is needed for rare but potentially fatal pancreatitis in patients taking GLP-1 drugs for diabetes or weight loss, the MHRA says.
